featured_reviews.name: Aryan Chile
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful shopping experience at Star Bazar - Churchgate. The store is very well-organized, clean, and stocked with a wide variety of products ranging from groceries and daily essentials to household items and snacks. Everything was arranged properly, making shopping very convenient and hassle-free.

What stood out the most was the quality of service. The staff members were polite, helpful, and always ready to assist whenever needed. Billing was smooth and quick even during busy hours, which made the overall experience even better. The store also offers great discounts and deals on many products, making it a good place for regular shopping.

The freshness of fruits, vegetables, and bakery items was impressive, and the product variety gives you plenty of options to choose from. The atmosphere inside the store feels comfortable and spacious, making it easy to shop peacefully without feeling crowded.

The location is also very convenient, especially for people around Churchgate and nearby areas. Overall, a reliable and excellent supermarket for everyday shopping needs. Definitely deserving of 5 stars for maintaining quality, service, and customer satisfaction consistently.

featured_reviews.name: Camo
featured_reviews.review_text:
In my view, this is one of the largest Westside stores in Mumbai, and it feels very much like the brand’s HQ outlet. The store spans two spacious floors, offering a wide range of options to explore. A good tip is to ask the staff about the latest collections on display, upcoming arrivals, or specific products that match your interests.

The staff here are multilingual — at least two languages including English — which makes communication easy. Given the store’s size, peak hours can lead to some queues at the payment kiosks, which might be mildly inconvenient. That said, I had a particularly positive experience when a male staff member went out of his way to help me complete a purchase, even though it was just for a single item. It reflected genuine customer care and efficiency.

Adding to the convenience, the store is directly connected to a Starbucks. It’s perfect for grabbing a coffee after shopping, or starting with one before diving into the store’s offerings.

featured_reviews.name: Rutika Omble
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the distinct pleasure of visiting the Starbucks at Kala Ghoda, and I must say, the experience was nothing short of exemplary.
Naina and Krisha attended to me with a level of grace, attentiveness, and refinement that one rarely encounters. Their recommendations were both thoughtful and impeccably suited to my preferences, reflecting not only a deep familiarity with the menu but also a genuine desire to ensure a most agreeable experience.
What truly set them apart, however, was their demeanour unfailingly courteous, warmly engaging, and possessed of a quiet humility that made the entire interaction feel effortlessly elegant.
It is no exaggeration to say that their service elevated a simple coffee visit into something altogether more delightful. A thoroughly splendid experience, and one I should be most pleased to repeat.

featured_reviews.name: Anusuya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Westside Fort – A Timeless Favourite

Westside at Fort has always held a special place in my heart. I have been visiting this particular store for the past 16 years and it continues to draw me in not just for its offerings but for the charm it exudes from the outside in.

What truly sets this Westside apart is the beautiful exterior architecture. Housed in a heritage style building its classic facade with arched windows and vintage detailing always catches my eye. There is a certain old world charm to it that makes it stand out from other Westside outlets in the city.

Inside the shopping experience is equally delightful. The women’s section has a lovely collection of Indian kurtas – stylish comfortable, versatile and affordable. Whether I am looking for something casual or festive, I always find something that suits my taste. The shoe section, too, is impressive with a good variety for both men and women.

The cherry on top is the Starbucks housed right within the building. After a satisfying round of shopping, it is the perfect spot to unwind with a coffee and soak in the Fort atmosphere.

Westside Fort is not just a store – it is a comforting familiar space that blends the charm of old Bombay with the convenience of modern retail. A true favourite over the years.

featured_reviews.name: D M
featured_reviews.review_text:
We enjoy shopping at Westside outlets for their sophisticated designs and colours.

However, let me specifically tell you what makes this outlet special-

1. Often found more variety of products assuming many local and international travellers visit this area in Mumbai.
2. Starbucks inside the outlet to have a quick coffee/bite on a shopping spree.
3. Located in the iconic Army Navy Building attracting architecture enthusiasts.

I will recommend visiting!

featured_reviews.name: Anoop Kamath
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is probably the best Westside outlet in India located in a heritage building near Kalaghoda, Mumbai.
The collection in this shop is amazing for women, men and kids. The staff is quite helpful and shopping here is an experience. Best affordable brand in India.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Dixit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Fab India Experience Center in Mumbai, and I must say, it was an incredible experience. This sprawling 10,000 sq. ft. store offers a unique blend of traditional Indian culture and modern retail therapy. From the moment I stepped in, I was impressed by the vast array of products on display.

*What I Loved:*

- *Cultural Shopping*: The center boasts an extensive collection of everyday wear and occasion wear for men, women, and kids, all infused with traditional Indian flavors.
- *Edible Delights*: The in-house FabCafe serves nutritious and innovative dishes like jackfruit momos, beetroot tikki, and oats idli, making it a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy healthy Indian food.
- *Souvenirs and Decorations*: The store offers a range of home and lifestyle products, including furniture, linen, and decorative items, perfect for gifting or personal use.
- *Wellness Center*: The Organic India Wellness Center provides a designated space for customers to explore various aspects of health, lifestyle, and well-being.

What sets Fab India Experience Center apart is its ability to offer everything under one roof. Whether you're looking for clothing, home decor, or just a delicious meal, this place has got you covered. The Interior Design Studio is an added bonus, providing expert services for layout consultancy, space mapping, and product customization.

Overall, my experience at Fab India Experience Center was truly delightful. The ambiance, product range, and services all come together to create a memorable experience. If you're looking for a one-stop destination for all your shopping and dining needs, look no further than Fab India Experience Center
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hey Gaurav! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are glad you found your experience good. We will continue to work on improving to exceed your expectations. If there's anything specific we can do better, please feel free to write us at fabcare@fabindia.net. Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: grin green
featured_reviews.review_text: Men’s clothing, tableware, home decor and small food section on ground level.  Kids’ on 2nd and for ladies, take the elevator to 3rd.  Prices are affordable, quality and variety is splendid.  Changing rooms were spacious.  We enjoyed our shopping here.  Service was courteous and would like to especially thank Mr Jogesh.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Sir/Ma'am, Thank you so much for your kind words. We really appreciate you taking the time to share your valuable feedback. Your satisfaction with our services is what keeps us striving harder. We wish to serve you at the same pace in the future as well.

featured_reviews.name: Vikkie
featured_reviews.review_text: Fabindia Kalaghoda has deteriorated significantly … the changing room has no AC vent & a brand new kurta had a hole in the pocket
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Vikkie! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent visit to our Fabindia Kalaghoda store. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced with the changing room and the quality issue with your new kurta. This is certainly not the standard of experience we aim to deliver. Please could you share with us the images of the product in question, including a full-length long shot image and a close-up image showing the defect, along with the invoice/purchase details at fabcare@fabindia.net, to enable us to look into this. Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: Ramees
featured_reviews.review_text:
Used to be a great brand. Now it’s poor quality products skimming us on price based on the brand equity.

After a very long time I got a couple of shirts from the Fab India outlet. The sales person said there would be a 2% shrinkage. So I got an L size that fit me very loose. After the first wash, the shirts are unwearable. The sleeves are comically short and the whole fabric is wrinkled and crumpled. Just really poor quality cotton. Never again.

If you’re considering Fab India, just don’t. Your money is probably better off with brands like Cotton world or No nasties.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Ramees! We are deeply sorry for the disappointing experience you have had with us. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve our services, and we appreciate the time you have taken to share your thoughts. Please be assured that we will share your feedback with our team. For any assistance, please feel free to write to us at fabcare@fabindia.net. We are always here to help

featured_reviews.name: PMoodley
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fabindia advertises products online that are not available in-store. Staff were unfriendly and unhelpful. After paying for a pair of chappals, I noticed—while still inside the store and before leaving—that one sandal was damaged and did not match the other. I immediately refused to take the defective item.
This was not an isolated issue; I had already pointed out another damaged pair of juttis on display, indicating that defective merchandise is being offered for sale. A communication barrier made resolution difficult.
Despite this being a clear case of defective goods, the store refused a refund, stating that refunds are only applicable to online purchases. This policy was unreasonable given that payment had just been made and the defect was identified immediately.
Only after I firmly asserted my consumer rights did the staff agree to process a card reversal. This review reflects my experience and is shared in good faith, pending confirmation that the refund is actually completed. A dismissive and condescending attitude toward customers..
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: ​Dear Sir/Mam, We are deeply sorry to hear that your experience with us did not meet your expectations. We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with us, as it is invaluable in helping us improve our services. If there is anything else we can do to assist you or if you have any further concerns, please feel free to reach out to us at fabcare@fabindia.net. We are always here to listen and help. Thank you for your feedback, and we hope to have the opportunity to serve you better in the future.
